create.name: Ramakrishna Vedanta Ashrama (Vedanta Brasil)
create.bio:
The Ramakrishna Vedanta Ashrama in São Paulo is the Brazilian centre of the Ramakrishna Order of India, and its YouTube channel, Vedanta Brasil, carries its teaching in Portuguese. A group of devotees of Sri Ramakrishna started it in 1974; in 1999 it became the first centre in Brazil formally affiliated with the order's headquarters at Belur Math, when Swami Nirmalatmananda arrived as its first resident monk. He remains its president and spiritual director and also visits the movement's centres in Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte and Brasília.

The ashrama presents Vedanta as taught and lived by Sri Ramakrishna, Sri Sarada Devi and Swami Vivekananda. Its week centres on an evening arati in the temple with hymns, meditation and reading; Saturday and Sunday talks by the resident swamis, the Sunday one a commentary on the Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna; and a Wednesday scripture class, currently working through the Atmabodha. Hatha yoga classes run in person and online, and seekers can arrange interviews with the swami about spiritual practice. The channel, active since 2017, posts the weekly scripture classes and longer talks by visiting monks of the order.

courses.title: Aulas de Hatha Yoga
courses.description: Hatha yoga classes at the ashrama and online, combining postures, breathing, concentration, relaxation and meditation, taught by experienced yoga teachers.

Photo is the channel avatar, the Ramakrishna Order's emblem (shared by all its centres), not a photo of the São Paulo ashrama; the site's own images are small icons.
Belur Math (Ramakrishna Math & Mission) has its own plan (rank 1202); this is a Brazilian branch with its own Portuguese-language channel.
Hatha yoga page mentions health benefits in general terms; the item description avoids them. Teachers' bios mention yoga therapy studies (not used).
Swami Nirmalatmananda is not on Spiritpedia: possible future listing. Teachers file empty.
